verdict.rationale: Amplitude's APIs support some bulk-style actions—exporting/uploading cohorts, exporting event data, and pulling dashboard data via the Dashboard REST API—but there is no explicit documentation of a general-purpose bulk operations mechanism (e.g., batch create/update/delete across many items) framed for AI-native automation. missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk endpoint documentation, multi-item transaction support, AI-agent-oriented bulk automation examples, independent verification of bulk API reliability.
